Judge each case on the evidence from requirements.md vs. the actual code. Do not assume both cases have the same classification.

WHAT TO CHANGE
1. Fix lifecycle.py and/or test_lifecycle.py so that behaviour matches requirements.md exactly and all tests pass. Only fix what the diagnosis justifies — do not change a correct behaviour.

     "native": "<obsolete_assertion|implementation_defect>",
     "external": "<obsolete_assertion|implementation_defect>",
     "evidence": { ... }
   }

- Do not act on the pending CEO decision D-7 (transcription provider) — it is a separate project and out of scope.

REPORT BACK
- The two classifications and the one-line reason for each.
- Exact diffs you made (file, before, after).
- Verbatim test output.
- The final contents of diagnosis.json and improvements.md (if written).
